# ghost/quick-calculation

Quick Calculation (F-Droid): a timed multiple choice mental maths game with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and mixed series, with a results screen. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/quick-calculation
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation open_setup --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation start_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation answer --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation answer_many --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation finish_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/quick-calculation get_result --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_setup`: Open the Quick Calculation app
- `start_game`: Start a Quick Calculation game with addition
- `get_question`: What is the current quick calculation question?
- `answer`: Answer the quick calculation question with option 2
- `answer_many`: Answer the next three quick calculation questions with options 1, 2 and 3
- `finish_game`: End the quick calculation game and show the result
- `get_result`: What was my quick calculation score?
